target.outcome: log confirmed COVID-19 case rate per 10,000 population on day 80 after first confirmed case
target.pollutant: 2017 annual population-weighted PM2.5 concentration (micrograms per cubic metre)
target.geography: 36 OECD countries listed in the article (35 complete-case countries fitted)
target.period: country-specific first confirmed case through day 80, January--May 2020; exposure year 2017
target.effect_scale: OLS coefficient on log case rate per 10,000 for a 1 microgram/m3 PM2.5 increase

substitutions.reanalysis: JHU CSSE country cumulative confirmed-case time series
substitutions.reason: Independently retrieved public historical outcome source; same cumulative confirmed-case outcome and country-specific day rule.

substitutions.published: OECD GDP data (unit not specified in article)
substitutions.reanalysis: World Bank GDP per capita, current USD, 2019
substitutions.reason: Public, reproducible GDP series; article did not identify its GDP unit.

coverage.notes: All country-specific day-80 outcome dates are available. United States excluded from fitted model because physician data were unavailable under the article's 2015--2017 fallback rule.

effect.scale: change in log day-80 confirmed-case rate per 10,000
